title: Floor plan
suits: talks and pitches about places, buildings, journeys, navigation, maps, real estate, wayfinding, games with levels, or anything 'one room further' each slide; a 'you are here' dot walks one endless plan.

params.Plan.config({ views, backX, noclip, dur: views = world top-left of each slide's window by slide number; backX = world x where rooms turn dense, half-built and endless; noclip = the step whose walk ignores doors; dur = glide ms (≤ 1200)
params.Plan.slide(id, { you, quiet, ey, leave,: you = the dot's resting spot (view px); quiet = rects with no generated walls; ey = approach level for the last leg; leave:'v' = leave vertically; mid = where the walk turns; demo = dashed renovation walls; lightsOff = rooms switch off on arrival
params.Plan.wall({ o, c, a, b, th, doors }): a fixed wall in world px (the reveal's threshold hall); doors with id animate in a reveal
params.Plan.reveal(id, T): draw a slide as a self-drawing reveal at time T (null = empty sheet, Infinity = done)
params.--ln / --accent on the section: line colour of walls, grid, doors (blueprint #CFE1FF, amber #F2C14E) and the dot / footsteps colour
params.[data-keep] / data-keep=\"0\": DOM content that carves the plan (default 26 px padding)

details: one world: each slide is a window onto the same seeded plan, so the building is continuous
a forward step glides the window (ease-out, ≤ 1.1 s) while the content cuts; back and jumps show the rest frame
the dot leaves alternating left/right footsteps, older ones fainter; the rest frame keeps them so print shows the route
doors on the route are closed until the dot reaches them, then swing open in its walking direction
every other door is drawn at 90° with its swing arc, plan convention
walls are hatched poché between two hairlines; the 40/200 px grid pans with the plan
past backX the generator cuts smaller rooms, leaves walls half-built, adds pillars and dashed ceiling troffers; one troffer flickers out of step
the noclip step has no doors: each wall the dot passes through jitters and dims for a moment
lightsOff: each block flickers once and goes dark at its own seeded time; footsteps fade; the dot dims to an ember
demo: the same walls redrawn dashed, a renovation drawing's 'to be demolished'
the dot pulses a ring every 2.6 s on the one clock
floor-plan-rev.js: a red-pencil revision cloud with its numbered delta as the deck's emphasis device
